messages:
Maya (Partnerships): quick sync — want to kick off a 6–8 week ramp for a new systems integrator partner. goal: get 3 engineers certified, 1 pilot deployed, and co-branded case study by EOW+8. thoughts?
Arun (SI Enablement): love it. propose a 4-step program: 1) pre-read + quick quiz, 2) two live train-the-trainer sessions, 3) hands-on lab week with sandbox access, 4) certification checklist + badge. keep it lightweight.
Kelly (Sales Ops): timeline check — sales will need a 2-week lead to prep the pilot contract and discounts. also need partner-level pricing doc.
Jin (Solutions Eng): lab access ok but we need ephemeral infra creds and a small GPU quota. can we give them a shared "SI-sandbox" project with usage cap? I can automate cleanup.
Maya (Partnerships): yes please. Arun — can you draft the train-the-trainer agenda? Jin — can you sketch the sandbox perms & quota? Kelly — can you own the pricing doc and pilot terms?
Arun (SI Enablement): draft agenda outline attached below (short bullets):
```
- 60m: Redwood platform overview + deployment modes
- 90m: Dedicated & Private deployment walkthrough (config, network, KMS)
- 60m: Troubleshooting common infra issues + logs/traces
- 120m: Hands-on: deploy sample app -> verify latency/SLOs
- 30m: Certification criteria + scoring rubric
```
Arun (SI Enablement): certification criteria (short): pass quiz (80%), complete lab task (deploy + validate), submit one runbook doc, sign co-marketing LOI.
Jin (Solutions Eng): sandbox perms: create project scoped to partner org, role = infra-admin for 3 seats, GPU quota 2xA10 per project, VPC peering allowed but restricted egress. I'll drop a terraform snippet in the runbook.
Kelly (Sales Ops): I'll prep two templates: an exploratory MOU and a pilot statement-of-work. need partner legal contact.
Ruth (Legal): ping me the draft SOW early — we should avoid open indemnities and clarify data residency for Private deployments. also attach standard redwood IP CLA for partner deliverables.
Maya (Partnerships): markers of success? suggest metrics: time-to-first-successful-deploy, # engineers certified, pilot conversion rate, and NPS from partner engineers.
Arun (SI Enablement): agree. propose weekly checkpoints and a post-pilot retro. also include a short eval harness (small prompt set + perf tests) so we can measure regressions during training.
Jin (Solutions Eng): small note: for the lab tasks, we'll use the sample app that exercises batch/stream modes and cache warmup — will surface typical perf profiles.
Maya (Partnerships): co-marketing checklist for case study: partner quote, architecture diagram, performance numbers (p90 latency, cost savings), logos and signed LOI. Kelly — can you coordinate creative + comms?
Kelly (Sales Ops): yep. I'll loop in marketing and request assets. timeline: need draft case study 2 weeks after pilot sign-off.
Ruth (Legal): will review LOI and marketing language. also confirm no customer PII will be published.
onboarding-bot: reminder set: 1941238000 -> "SI ramp kickoff meeting"
Maya (Partnerships): action items: Arun = train agenda & quiz, Jin = sandbox terraform + runbook, Kelly = pricing & SOW templates + coordinate marketing, Ruth = legal review window. I'll schedule kickoff for Tue 10am PT.
Arun (SI Enablement): noted. will upload materials to the partner folder and tag the group.
Jin (Solutions Eng): adding a short troubleshooting checklist for the lab (GPU OOM, network routes, auth token refresh).
Kelly (Sales Ops): I'll share partner contact and contract owner by EOD.
Maya (Partnerships): thanks team. small ask: can we add a lightweight "trainer shadow" session where our SE watches an SI-led run? helps quality control.
Arun (SI Enablement): good idea — include as a mandatory step before badge issuance.
Maya (Partnerships): perfect. closing — will post calendar invite and repo link. :rocket:
